requested_by_user: Fetch latest main; run five agents making music as early-alpha novice users; record UI discovery and confusion for later evaluation.

participants.background: Casual music listener; no DAW experience
participants.goal: Catchy electronic melody; repeat, save, export
Original dance beat; second sound; save, export

participants.background: Hobby guitarist; knows music but no DAW
participants.goal: Bass riff and higher melody; balance; save, export
Soft chord progression and tune; space effect; save, export
Atmospheric loop from included sampler or synth; layer and add space; save, export

task_method.interface: Native application under independent Xvfb displays; screenshot inspection and native mouse/keyboard events
task_method.fresh_state: Separate config, cache, scratch and PulseAudio sink per participant. Default application demo is allowed on launch.
task_method.allowed_knowledge: Visible UI, supplied persona and goal, driver mechanics, required AGENTS.md contributor rules
task_method.disallowed_shortcuts: No source/user guide/prior-study inspection, no headless automation, MCP, injected project files or prewritten compositions
task_method.independence: Agents started without parent conversation history and were not shown other participants findings. Coordinator relayed only environmental facts and requested recording measurements.
task_method.recording: 3 fps desktop recording plus actual monitor output, screenshot milestones, timestamped input log and chronological observation notes
task_method.notes_scope: Concise simulated expectations, intentions, actions, observed outcomes and discoveries; not private internal reasoning
task_method.duration: Approximately 15–20 minute exploratory sessions; count actual input operations and outcomes, no success quota

limitations: Simulated beginner perspectives from AI agents, not recruited humans; musical goals provide context the actual product may not provide.
Agents share a model family and coordinator; cross-session themes are signals for evaluation, not population prevalence estimates.
Required AGENTS.md included contributor-level interface conventions, though agents did not read source or user workflow documentation.
No physical headphones, MIDI controller or recording hardware; sound quality and tactile timing not assessed.
Unoptimized development build on four shared CPU cores; repeated ALSA/PulseAudio errors confound real-time audition.
Native chooser missing GTK schema setup was repaired during early exploration; earlier affected attempts are environment-confounded.
No code fixes were made during the study.

Missing window-manager focus restoration caused some keyboard/shortcut noops after native file pickers; input driver restored normal focus behavior mid-study. Relevant earlier attempts remain recorded and are environment-confounded.
